name: packaging_labeling contextual-knowledge evaluation
label: SYNTHETIC ENGINEERING EVALUATION - invented rules and expectations, no independent domain review

cases.description: Compliant PX-200 carton in Northland after revision 2; revision 1 is superseded.
Same carton with 7 pt text fails the revised Northland rule; the 6 pt baseline still passes.
Before revision 2 takes effect, revision 1 (7 pt) applies and 7 pt passes.
Bitemporal view: as_of August but known_as 1 June, revision 2 was not yet recorded.
Authorised waiver: the PX-200-MINI carton is exempt from the 8 pt rule; the 6 pt baseline applies.
Unauthorised override: a more specific Sunleaf brand rule claims to override the 6 pt baseline.
A customer permission does not override a market prohibition.
Contradictory mandatory storage statements (market vs customer) with no approved resolution.
The same contradiction for the mini-pack is resolved by an approved precedence exception.
Market not stated: market-scoped rules are unknown, not silently applied or dropped.
Missing and unevidenced facts leave mandatory checks as insufficient evidence.
Declared absence semantics: a missing allergen statement is a violation, not unknown.
Regression: semantically attractive advisory content ranked first does not displace a mandatory rule.
Restricted rule is evaluated for a caller in the authorised group.
Restricted rule is invisible to other callers, even when its fact would fail.
Tenant isolation: another tenant sees none of this pack and escalates for missing knowledge.
Unknown applicability metadata (undeclared brand scope) escalates instead of applying.
Draft and withdrawn entries are never served.
One carton sold in two markets: both markets' rules apply together.
A failed recommendation is reported but does not block; mandatory rules stay in force.
Prohibited claim present in Northland for a non-MegaMart customer is a violation.
Orthogonal dimensions: MegaMart + Sunleaf + Southland mini-pack combines customer, brand and market rules.
A waiver scoped to one market does not waive the requirement for the other market in the request.
A precedence whose winner does not apply does not suppress the losing requirement.
A prohibition whose fact is declared absence-is-violation fails when the fact is missing.
A fact of the wrong type is insufficient evidence, never a pass or a crash.
